title: Unit theme
description: A flat, airy fintech light theme: pure white page, pure black ink and black pill actions, a cool green-tinted off-white for bands and chips, slate-teal secondary text, and pastel lilac, aqua, lime and mint for hover tints and glows. One regular weight of a Swiss neo-grotesk throughout. A true-black dark sibling.
notes: light is the faithful mode; the closing band and the platform panel are dark islands (class `dark`) inside it
chart-1…4 are the four pastel hover tints of the product cards (lilac, aqua, lime, mint)
